reason: A separate follow-on vector after the H4/D1 transition family set failed its discovery gates. This is not a threshold or parameter rescue of that study.

allowed: raw closed M1 aggregated to causal M15 OHLC tick_volume spread

VOLUME_ABSORPTION_REVERSAL.condition: current M15 tick volume >= past-only rolling-60 P80; true range <= 0.80 ATR14; directional wick >= 45% of range; close is back beyond the bar midpoint away from the wick
VOLUME_ABSORPTION_REVERSAL.event: first eligible closed M15 bar after ineligibility

VOLUME_CLIMAX_CONTINUATION.condition: current M15 tick volume >= past-only rolling-60 P90; true range >= 1.50 ATR14; close location >= 0.80 for LONG or <= 0.20 for SHORT; close beyond prior 8-bar range
VOLUME_CLIMAX_CONTINUATION.event: first eligible closed M15 bar after ineligibility

DRYUP_PULLBACK_RESUMPTION.condition: EMA20 and EMA50 aligned; previous closed M15 bar touched EMA20, had tick volume <= 0.70 past-only rolling-20 median and range <= 0.80 ATR14; current bar volume >= 1.20 median and closes beyond previous extreme in trend direction
DRYUP_PULLBACK_RESUMPTION.event: first resumption after each dry-up pullback

EFFORT_RESULT_DIVERGENCE_REVERSAL.condition: three-bar tick-volume sum >= past-only rolling-60 P80 of three-bar sums; absolute three-bar net close progress <= 0.30 ATR14; current close breaks the previous bar extreme away from the prior three-bar net direction
EFFORT_RESULT_DIVERGENCE_REVERSAL.direction: opposite the prior three-bar net direction
EFFORT_RESULT_DIVERGENCE_REVERSAL.event: first eligible closed M15 bar after ineligibility

VOLUME_STATE_RELEASE.condition: past five-bar mean tick volume divided by past twenty-bar mean was <=0.80 on prior bar and is >=1.50 now; current close breaks prior 8-bar range
VOLUME_STATE_RELEASE.event: first eligible closed M15 bar after ineligibility

selection: Select exactly one complete discovery-gate pass with highest PF; tie within 0.01 uses lower DD then family id. If none pass, do not inspect evaluation outcomes.
